paper_metadata.title: Novel wrought γ/γ′ cobalt base superalloys with high strength and improved oxidation resistance

evidence.quote: New polycrystalline Co-base superalloys with γ/γ′ microstructure have been developed, which show excellent mechanical properties and enhanced oxidation behavior.
Both Udimet 720Li and Waspaloy exhibit a polycrystalline two-phase γ/γ′ microstructure and are widely used in gas turbine applications.
two Co-base superalloys, CoWAlloy1 and CoWAlloy2, are investigated and compared with the commercial wrought Ni-base superalloys Udimet 720Li and Waspaloy (Table 1).
